notes.piece: A ringed gas giant rising over the horizon of a small airless moon, seen from its surface.
notes.light: The sun is off the upper left: every sphere is gibbous with its night side to the lower right, the rings shadow the planet, the planet shadows the rings, and ground shadows fall to the right.
notes.layers: Stars, back ring, planet, night side, ring shadow, front ring, ground; hand-painted detail goes on top.
